commit.message:
RISC-V: Prefer vmv.v.i to zero a vector register (remaining sites)

Extend the "prefer vmv.v.i vd, 0" idiom to the remaining RVV zeroing
sites for consistency:

  - riscv_v.ad: rearrange_masked, vcompress, vexpand, gather_loadS_masked
    and gather_loadD_masked, each zeroing dst via a self-XOR
    (vxor.vv dst, dst, dst).
  - c2_MacroAssembler_riscv.cpp: arrays_hashcode_v zeroed v_sum with
    vmv.v.x v_sum, x0.
  - macroAssembler_riscv.cpp: the three CRC helpers (vector_update_crc32
    and the two kernel_crc32_vclmul_fold_vectorsize_* paths) zeroed the
    initial-CRC vector with vmv.v.x vd, zr.

Only true whole-vector zeroing sites are converted; genuine XORs with
distinct source registers are left unchanged. Semantically equivalent.
RISC-V: Prefer vmv.v.i to zero a vector register
